_comment: Pre-canned loadouts for the 4 onboarding styles (docs/SPEC.md 1.3 speed rule). Paths are relative to the repo root. Build a match config with: node tools/style-config.js <style> [--soft] [--out bots.styles.json]

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.description: Hold a corner and let them come to you: banks energy for replacements, guard drones wall off the hero.
opening: Hero takes the corner, guards form a wall
Hold: let them come into range
Bank energy for a new hero

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Find the enemy and keep the pressure on: chases contacts and swarms them in waves.
opening: Waves of swarm keep the pressure

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.description: Keep your distance and pick them off: long-range full-power shots, kites anything that closes in.
opening: Hero backs off to long range
Hero kites anything that closes in

wildcard.name: Wildcard
wildcard.description: Unpredictable and hard to read: random moves and timing, but it still aims true.
opening: Dice pick the moves and the timing
Chaos drones dive whoever shows up

_comment_softRivals: softRivals = handicap {energyRate, planEveryTicks} the 3 NPC rivals get in this style's soft first fight (tools/style-config.js --soft); tuned with tools/style-balance.js --soft. Default (if missing): src/config.js commander.softHandicap.
_comment_arsenal: arsenal = default pre-match drones for the style (SPEC 5.1, budget commander.arsenalBudget = 120, 20 per drone; the rest is starting energy). opening = 3 short lines for the loadout card (tools/loadout-card.js); the opening map art is assets/loadout/maps/<style>.svg.
